meta.title: Admin
meta.description: GnomeVPN users, payments, promo codes and nodes.

export.truncated: Exported the first {max} rows of a longer list — narrow the filter

validation.codeFormat: A code is {codeMin}–{codeMax} latin letters and digits
validation.codeShape: The code looks like a friend or gift code — change its length or add 0, O, 1, I or L
validation.percent: A discount is a whole number from {percentMin} to {percentMax} %
validation.days: Days are a whole number from {daysMin} to {daysMax}
validation.maxUses: The limit is a whole number from 1, or leave it empty

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: What is happening right now. The same numbers as /stats in the bot.

payments.label: Revenue for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}

analytics.title: Trends
analytics.description: Days are UTC days. Revenue is succeeded payments by the date they were created; refunds are not in it.

paidVsTrials.title: New paid accounts and free days
paidVsTrials.caption: First succeeded subscription payment and free-day starts, per day, last {days} days
paidVsTrials.empty: No first payments and no free days in this period

conversion.label: Free day to payment
conversion.hint: {converted} of the {trials} who took a free day in the last {days} days have paid. Recent free days may still convert.
conversion.noTrials: No free days in the last {days} days

referrals.title: Invitations
referrals.empty: Nobody was invited in this period.
referrals.caption: Invitations made in the last {days} days and the days granted for them

revenue.title: Revenue per day
revenue.caption: Succeeded payments by the day they were created, last {days} days, refunds excluded

payments.title: Payments per day
payments.caption: Succeeded payments counted by the day they were created, last {days} days

signups.title: Sign-ups per day
signups.caption: New accounts by the day they signed up, last {days} days
signups.empty: Nobody signed up in this period

captions.plan: Subscription payments over the last {days} days by plan — extra devices, gifts and refunds excluded
captions.kind: Every succeeded payment over the last {days} days by kind, refunds excluded

growth.title: Growth
growth.caption: What invites, win-back discounts and payment reminders brought in over the last {days} days
growth.empty: No invite payments, win-back discounts or payment reminders in this period.

referredPayments.label: Payments from invites
referredPayments.hint: Succeeded subscription payments by accounts that came by invite, refunds excluded

winBack.label: Win-back: offered / used / revenue
winBack.hint: Automatic discounts for lapsed customers, the payments made with them and their sum

checkoutReminders.label: Payment reminders: sent / came back
checkoutReminders.hint: Reminders about an unfinished payment, and how many of those reminded then paid for a subscription

users.title: Users
users.description: Newest first. Click an email to open the card.
users.caption: Users

search.label: Search
search.hint: Emails, names and @usernames match in part, Telegram ids and user ids exactly.

verify.title: Confirm the email without the letter?
verify.body: {email} will count as confirmed, as if the link in the letter had been opened. Only do this once you are sure the mailbox is theirs.

message.label: Message in Telegram
message.hint: Plain text, sent as the bot.
message.title: Send the message?
message.body: They will receive it from the GnomeVPN bot. It cannot be taken back.

outcomes.notLinked: This user has no linked Telegram
outcomes.blocked: The user has blocked the bot
outcomes.botOff: The bot is off on the server
outcomes.failed: Telegram did not accept the message

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.none: No subscription and no free day yet.

cancelRenewal.title: Turn auto-renewal off?
cancelRenewal.body: The card stays linked, but there will be no next charge. They can turn renewal back on themselves.

extend.label: Extend by, days
extend.title: Extend access by {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}?
extend.body: Access will last until {date}. The days are added to the current term, or counted from today if it has already ended. Disabled devices start working again.

link.title: Subscription link
link.description: The admin panel never shows the link itself.

rotate.title: Issue a new subscription link?
rotate.body: The old link stops working and the devices that fetched it are disconnected — they will have to add the new link to INCY or another app again.

remove.title: Remove “{name}”?
remove.body: Its keys are deleted from the nodes on the next reconcile. If the app fetches the subscription again, the device is added back while there is a free place.

promo.title: Promo codes and gifts
promo.empty: No codes entered, no gifts bought.

payments.title: Payments
payments.description: Newest first. The totals cover every payment under the filter, not only this page.
payments.caption: Payments

refund.title: Refund {amount} in full?
refund.body: The money goes back through YooKassa: {who}. Access, invitation days and the gift are taken back by the refund webhook once YooKassa confirms it. Until then the payment reads «Refund requested».
refund.requested: Refund requested — waiting for YooKassa to confirm it
refund.failed: YooKassa did not accept the refund. Check the shop balance and try later — or refund it in the YooKassa dashboard.

form.title: New code
form.description: The same rules as /promo in the bot.
form.codeHint: Latin letters and digits, no spaces
form.untilHint: Until 23:59 Moscow time. Empty means no expiry
form.refused: The server refused the code: check that the last day has not passed and the values are within range.

campaigns.title: Campaign codes
campaigns.description: Newest first. Payments and revenue are succeeded payments discounted with the code.

stop.title: Stop {code}?
stop.body: New redemptions stop at once. A discount someone already redeemed stays theirs.

effect.noRevenue: No discounted payments with these codes yet.
effect.usedCaption: How often the codes on this page were redeemed
effect.revenueCaption: Succeeded payments discounted with the code, refunds excluded

gifts.title: Gifts
gifts.description: Read only: a gift belongs to its buyer and only a refund revokes it. The code is hidden.

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.description: Every node, including those out of rotation. State and uptime are computed exactly as on the /status page.

off.title: Take {name} out of rotation?
off.body: The node leaves the subscriptions on their next refresh, the /status page and the minute checks. Keys on the node itself are untouched, so open connections do not drop at once.

on.title: Put {name} back into rotation?
on.body: The node comes back to the subscriptions on their next refresh and to the /status page.
